newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal targets average 6.0 pct growth to 2001.
newsitem.headline: Senegal targets average 6.0 pct growth to 2001.

text.p: Senegal is aiming for average six percent annual economic growth up to 2001, Economy Minister Papa Ousmane Sacko said on Monday.

"The average rate of economic growth each year should be around six percent at least in the period 1996-2001, which is far above the demographic growth of 2.8 percent," Sacko told a forum of Canadian and Senegalese businessmen.
Gross domestic product growth in 1996 was estimated at 5.2 percent, against 4.8 percent in 1995. Inflation was held to around 2.7 percent in 1996.
Senegal aims to reduce its trade balance deficit from 8.3 percent of GDP to 3.8 percent by 2000.
The West African country expects to balance its budget by 1998, the minister said.
